note: The deployed finance dashboard -> finance agent ONLY (scoped to o.product_pl). frontend id is the wire identity (fe-finance-dashboard) and names the fe:<frontend>:<conv> thread. All four *_env keys name entries in .env (never put the token/url/secret here — this file is gitignored but the schema example ships). token_env: the Bearer token the dashboard presents inbound. callback_url_env: where astryx POSTs the answer. callback_token_env (optional): the Bearer token astryx presents so the dashboard can authenticate us. callback_secret_env (optional): HMAC key astryx signs the outbound body with (X-Astryx-Signature: sha256=...).
